title: I Got This... FAHHHHH
blurb: Two seconds, two completely different moods: 'I got this' delivered with total confidence, then FAHHHHH as reality arrives dead on schedule. The full arc of overconfidence sits inside one clip, which is why editors reach for it constantly — setup and punchline are baked into the same file, so there is nothing to time. Lay it over a skateboard trick, a DIY project, an ambitious tackle, or anybody announcing a plan directly to camera. It works best of all on your own footage, where you already know exactly how the story ends and are choosing to show it anyway.
